    Separating field-valued points by matrix ranks #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_nonzero_rank_minor {K : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K) :
    ∃ (r : Fin A.rank → m) (c : Fin A.rank → n), (A.submatrix r c).det ≠ 0

    There is a square minor of size equal to the rank and with nonzero determinant.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finite_of_separating_ring_elements {A : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {K : I → Type u_3} [(i : I) → Field (K i)] (ev : (i : I) → A →+* K i) (f : I → A) (hn : ∀ (i : I), (ev i) (f i) ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (ev j) (f i) = 0) :
    Finite I

    A family of field-valued points of a Noetherian ring is finite if each point can be distinguished from all the others by a single nonvanishing function.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finite_of_separating_matrix_ranks {A : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {K : I → Type u_3} [(i : I) → Field (K i)] (ev : (i : I) → A →+* K i) (m : I → Type u_4) (n : I → Type u_5) [(i : I) → Fintype (m i)] [(i : I) → Fintype (n i)] (M : (i : I) → Matrix (m i) (n i) A) (h : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → ((M i).map ⇑(ev j)).rank < ((M i).map ⇑(ev i)).rank) :
    Finite I

    At each point suppose some matrix over the parameter ring has strictly larger rank there than at every other point. The residue fields and the test matrix may both depend on the point.
